name: De-rustle
author: Vocal Monitor
description: Catches lavalier-mic clothing rustle and mic-handling crackle. Sidechain 24 dB/oct HP at ~5 kHz feeds fast/slow envelopes; when the fast env overshoots the slow we crossfade a high-shelf cut onto the main signal for the duration of the event. iZotope RX De-rustle family.
